text: PB - As a User, I want to re-order pages within the same parent/root via Nav - FE UI component
llm_output:

And the Navigation Panel is open and displaying pages under the same parent

Then the page should move to the new position  
And the updated page order should be saved and persist across editing and viewing modes until changed again by the user

text: PB - As a User, I want to see a new landing page
llm_output:
Scenario: Viewing the New Landing Page  
Given a user navigates to the website's homepage  
When the user accesses the website after the new landing page has been deployed  
Then the user should see the new landing page with updated design and content  
And the page should load without errors or delays  
And all interactive elements on the landing page should function as intended.

text: PB - As a User, I want to create a Drag & Drop Page (as a standalone Page) from Nav
llm_output:

text: PB - As a User, I want to only select & see the combo of Widget and Block (bounding box experience) in Page Builder
llm_output:

And the page contains multiple widgets and blocks  
When the user clicks on a widget or block  
Then the selected widget and its associated block should be highlighted together within a bounding box  
And only the selected widget and block combo should be visually emphasized while other elements remain unselected  
And the bounding box should clearly indicate the boundaries of the selected combo for editing purposes.

text: As a User, I want to access Reply action for New Replies in Daily Digest Email
llm_output:

Then the user should be redirected to the reply interface on the platform

text: As a user I want to see 'Bulk Review' in bulk review page header (page name)
llm_output:

text: As a user, I want to be able to see the GIF or Lottie File converted MP4 on the Markup Screen in Approvals so that I can markup the animation to get feedback and new revisions worked on
llm_output:
Scenario: Viewing Converted MP4 Animation on Markup Screen for Feedback  
Given a user is on the Markup Screen in the Approvals section  
And the system has successfully converted a GIF or Lottie File into an MP4 format  
When the user opens the animation file on the Markup Screen  
Then the MP4 animation should play seamlessly on the Markup Screen  
And the user should be able to pause, play, and scrub through the animation timeline  
And the user should be able to add markups directly on the animation for feedback purposes  
And the markups should be saved and associated with the specific frame of the animation.

text: PB - As a User, I want to see a new landing page
llm_output:

text: As a User, I want to open current location for single / same folder Move
llm_output:
Scenario: Opening Current Location for Moving a Folder  
Given a user is in the file management interface  
And the user has selected a folder to move  
When the user initiates the move action  
Then the current location of the selected folder should open automatically  
And the user should be able to select a new destination for the folder within the interface

text: As an Internal User, I want to have MCP(development use only) settings to enable/disable features per Epic for Drag & Drop Page MVP
llm_output:

text: As a User, I want Surface Question/Answer/Rating back end data in weekly report / script
llm_output:
Scenario: Generating Weekly Report with Question/Answer/Rating Data  
Given the backend system contains stored data for questions, answers, and ratings  
And the user has access to the reporting script  
When the user runs the weekly report script  
Then the report should include all questions, answers, and ratings data from the past week  
And the data should be organized by date and category  
And the report should be generated in a readable format (e.g., CSV or PDF)  
And the report should be available for download or email delivery to the user.

text: As a User, I want to switch Page Categories when viewing a Page if there are multiple Page Categories
llm_output:
Scenario: Switching Page Categories While Viewing a Page  
Given a user is viewing a page with multiple page categories available  
When the user selects a different page category from the category dropdown menu  
Then the content of the page should update to display the content associated with the selected category  
And the selected category should remain highlighted in the dropdown menu  
And the updated category selection should persist until the user changes it again.

text: PB - As a User, I want to add Widgets directly to a Section
llm_output:

Then the widget should appear within the selected section in the desired position  
And the widget should be fully functional and editable within the section  
And the changes should be saved and persist across editing and viewing modes until changed again by the user

text: BP - As a User, I want to single select resources from Resource Lookup with unchangeable filter based on file type in Page Builder
llm_output:
Scenario: Single Selecting a Resource from Resource Lookup with File Type Filter

text: As a user I want to run a stats report for database tool and see files from multi upload field represented each on their own row (excluding in Duplicable sections)
llm_output:
Scenario: Generating a Stats Report with Multi-Upload Field Files Represented Individually  
Given a user has access to the database tool and is on the stats report generation page  
And the database contains records with files uploaded in a multi-upload field  
And the records do not include files within duplicable sections  
When the user generates the stats report  
Then each file from the multi-upload field should be displayed on its own row in the report  
And no files from duplicable sections should be included in the report  
And the report should accurately reflect the data from the database.

text: As a user, I want to be able to preview the GIF or Lottie File converted MP4 on the Review Request screen in Approvals so that I can preview what the animation is when approving
llm_output:
Scenario: Previewing Converted MP4 Animation on Review Request Screen

Then the MP4 animation should play in a preview window or embedded player

And the user should be able to close the preview and return to the Review Request screen without losing any progress.

text: As a user, I want to see the database name and record name in the header

text: PB - (Misc) As a User, I want to be informed why the Page cannot be saved in Page Builder if it's beyond the set Page limit in MCP
llm_output:
Scenario: Displaying Error Message When Page Limit is Exceeded

Then an error message should be displayed informing the user that the page cannot be saved because the page limit has been exceeded  
And the page should not be saved or added to the Page Builder  
And the user should remain in the editing mode to make necessary adjustments.

text: As a User, I want to configure both Block and Video Widget properties
llm_output:

Then the user should be able to configure all available properties for the selected widget

text: As a Database Manager, I want to allow end users to Add More child records ('Add More') - Handle maximum child records
llm_output:
Scenario: Adding Child Records Up to the Maximum Limit  
Given a database manager has set a maximum limit for child records  
And an end user is on the interface where child records can be added  
And the current number of child records is below the maximum limit  
When the end user clicks the "Add More" button  
Then a new child record input field should appear  
And the total number of child records should increase by one  
And the "Add More" button should remain enabled if the maximum limit is not yet reached  
And the system should prevent adding more child records once the maximum limit is reached.
